name: AK16AA - Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity), App Connected
highlights: A Screen Shows Now; the App Shows the Pattern — Bluetooth logging turns a spot reading into a curve. Ventilation problems reveal themselves in the shape of an overnight CO₂ rise, and no display can show that.
Evidence a Client Will Accept — An indoor air consultant can hand over an exported trend rather than describe what the screen said during the visit.
Full Eight-Parameter Set — Everything AK16A measures, with wireless history added — the laser particulate split included.
2000 mAh, Six Hours — Bluetooth running does not materially shorten runtime. Three-hour USB-C charge.
Same Body, Same Carton — 233 g, 30 pcs per box — the connectivity tier without a change to your packing or freight calculation.
